info.title: Orvelt Business API
info.description: Public REST API for external Orvelt Business integrations. Every operation requires a project-scoped API key in the x-api-key header.

businessApiKey.name: x-api-key
businessApiKey.description: Project-scoped Orvelt Business API key. Create keys in Orvelt Business and keep them server-side.
